title: Clarify when HttpClient transport errors need translation
summary: Clarified documentation about when HTTP client transport errors require custom error translation, distinguishing between valid optional propagation and cases needing explicit error contracts without changing code samples.
key_points: Both optional Boolean propagation and explicit handling can be valid approaches for HTTP errors
Custom error labels for non-2xx responses don't automatically require transport-error translation
Require visible caller, documented error contract, or user-facing evidence before reporting missing translations
No changes to existing good/bad code samples or fixture selection
Documentation-only change with validation of article integrity and fixture coverage
quote: Clarify the existing HTTP platform-failure article without changing its fail-fast alternative
